data.body: LIVE PROBE RESULT (2026-06-06, full e2e_field_validation_probe run): dcf3's premise did NOT reproduce. Phase 6 idempotency — all 3 no-op passes reported '0 filtered mutations' (PASS). The reconciler CONVERGES; the differ does not re-emit the contended-scaffold fields, so the '6' is gone (likely resolved by intervening convergence work — plateau/rstrip 506acbac45, ticket_type 82b7fb2fe1, local-intent a06c, bound-but-absent 1e08). Combined with the earlier code trace (the $5/'match filter' count is taken AFTER inbound bidirectional suppression, reconcile.py:947-1015), the Phase-6 counter is CORRECT and the proposed 'read applied_count' fix remains rejected (would have masked any real non-convergence). RECOMMENDATION: close dcf3 as not-reproducible / counter-is-correct. TWO SEPARATE real defects surfaced by the same run and filed individually: (1) Phase 6a counter is vacuous (reads the -1 sentinel for all 10 passes); (2) Phase 8 local-delete fails on a prev_snapshot.json conflict, orphaning probe tickets. See newly-filed tickets.
